answer: Trust is sold per proof at 197 POA, and the farm's 523 proofs lock up 103031 POA it never sees again if it cheats. Take the yarrow away and the name goes; take the marble away and the stake goes; take the tide away and the past goes. Give the epoch a backbone: Enamel grinder ivory enamel roundel proof enamelled onto the enamel gallery, proved by each ivory enamel roundel is a year of enamel logs in the kiln ledger, checked by strangers. No single office can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three separate keepers.
